DM: So at this point also, Riswynn says goodbye, teleports away. “We’ll see you in Drankor,” or wherever, because she can teleport back to Vindristjarna once the Riswynn problem is dealt with. Which will conveniently take exactly as much time as it takes us to run whatever adventure we have between now and when we return from them— Colorado.

markers.note: Departure is mentioned during the May 13 preparation and again in the May 14 closing scene; its date is unresolved. Kethra was proposed at u2367–u2368, but the departure names only Riswynn.

markers.reading: Seeker teleports the allied Kenzo duplicate onto Vengeance’s deck; the alternative missed destination decays and does not become a visit.

evidence.quote: DM: Yeah, that would have been a dramatic miss. So you see, as Seeker casts Teleport, 2 versions of reality superimposed upon each other for a brief moment. You see, 1st of all, Kenzo, sailing off to some other ship, a pirate ship on the Green Sea, and then that reality decays quickly, and Kenzo vanishes in a flash, appearing by the Chanceweaver’s fate, on the deck of Dread Pirate Wellby’s ship, the Vengeance. And that is where we’ll end the session tonight.
